**Date**: 29 and 30 January, 2026  
**Location**: University of Zurich, [KOL](https://www.plaene.uzh.ch/KOL)-F-101, Rämistrasse 59, 8001 Zürich

[Register](https://forms.office.com/e/kRp1pxgrX6){.btn .btn-primary}  

Registration is free of charge. Registrations will be accepted on a first come, first served basis until **5 January 2026**.

[Submit a contribution](https://forms.office.com/e/p4JcqGtGNX){.btn .btn-primary}  

We invite contributions that critically examine how science operates and how it can be improved. See the [call for contributions](https://crsuzh.pages.uzh.ch/ror-event-2026/call/) for more information. The contribution submission deadline is on **1 November, 2025**.  

Join us to share your work, exchange ideas, and shape future Research on Research collaborations in Switzerland!

::: {#main-listing}
:::

Hosted by the [Center for Reproducible Science and Research Synthesis (CRS)](https://www.crs.uzh.ch/en.html)
